name: Eveready East Africa Plc
source: Eveready East Africa Plc annual report and financial statements for the year ended 30 September 2021, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (page 10), Group column, with the FY2020 comparatives printed on the same statement. Figures are printed in KSh thousands and stored as absolute KES. Cost of Sales and Operating Expenses are stored as positive magnitudes matching the existing rows; Income Tax is stored as a positive expense and a negative credit, verified against the printed PBT and loss for the year. | NSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: no audited accounts have been published since the year ended 30 September 2023, whose annual report was released on 3 June 2024. The document register at africanfinancials.com (company ke-evrd) ends with the unaudited half year to 31 March 2024 released 1 October 2024, and that filing carries interim figures only; the NSE copy of it is at https://nse.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/Eveready-East-Africa-Plc-Un-audited-Results-for-the-Six-Months-Period-Ended-31-Mar-2024.pdf. Audited FY2024 and FY2025 statements are not obtainable from any reachable source.

reconciliation_note: Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit, to the unit, for FY2023 and FY2022 (16,811 - 13,586 = 3,225 and (43,286) - 484 = (43,770); 82,624 - 59,595 = 23,029 and (11,729) - 39,137 = (50,866), KSh thousands). Gross Profit minus Operating Expenses does not equal the operating result on this statement because the issuer strikes it through Other Income, Impairment of Assets and Finance Costs. Operating Profit (EBIT) carries the cash flow statement line Operating loss before working capital changes, the same convention used for FY2021 and FY2020 in this file. Net Margin and Operating Margin for FY2023 are withheld: the loss exceeds revenue by more than the 100 percent plausibility bound, so the ratio is omitted rather than printed.
